Basis on the common treatment in ACS patients，all subjects and patients were given aspirin 100 $\mathbf { m } \mathbf { g } \cdot \mathbf { d } ^ { - 1 }$ ，clopidogrel 75 mg · $\mathrm { ~ d ~ } ^ { - 1 }$ ，and atorvastatin 20 $\mathbf { m } \mathbf { g } \cdot \mathbf { d } ^ { - 1 }$ ，5 days later discontinued the atorvastatin only. The $5 , 9$ days after treatment，the clopidogrel carboxylic acid derivatives blood concentration was measured by $\mathrm { H P L C \mathrm { ~ - ~ } M S / M S }$ ． The platelet aggregation rate was determinate by flow cytometry.
